articles.title: Man serving litchi juice to guests was shocked when a black rubber piece was spotted in the bottle; consumer commission orders manufacturer to pay Rs 22,340
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: A district consumer commission in Haryana has held a juice manufacturer liable for selling unsafe litchi juice after a laboratory test found a
articles.body: NEW DELHI: A district consumer commission in Haryana has held a juice manufacturer liable for selling unsafe litchi juice after a laboratory test found a black rubber piece floating inside a bottle purchased by a customer.The Rohtak District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission directed Fresca Foods to refund Rs 340 towards the purchase, pay Rs 2,000 in laboratory charges, Rs 15,000 as compensation and Rs 5,000 towards litigation costs, in its order dated October 15, 2026.Fresca litchi juice black rubber piece disputeAccording to the commission order, the complainant, Nishant Sikri, an advocate, purchased 40 bottles of 160 ml Fresca Litchi Drinks from Shree Mahavir Trading Co in Rohtak for Rs 340 on November 15, 2023.The purchase was made on the occasion of Bhaiya Dooj, when relatives had visited his residence. The complainant alleged that while serving the juice to his guests, a family member noticed a black-coloured foreign substance floating inside one of the bottles, embarrassing him in front of his relatives.He alleged that the manufacturer had failed to follow the required standards while manufacturing and packing the drink. He approached the retailer, which apologised and asked him to contact the manufacturer. However, he claimed that the manufacturer’s representatives ignored his complaints.The complainant approached the commission, seeking a refund of Rs 340 with interest, Rs 10 lakh as compensation for mental agony and harassment, and Rs 55,000 towards litigation expenses.Fresca Foods and its managing director failed to appear despite receiving notice and were proceeded against ex parte on July 16, 2024. The retailer, Shree Mahavir Trading Co, argued that it had purchased the bottles from another supplier, Bhatia Sons, in sealed and packed condition and sold them to the complainant without opening them. It denied the allegations and sought dismissal of the complaint.Commission's finding on Fresca litchi juiceThe bench comprising president Nagender Singh Kadian and members Dr Tripti Pannu and Dr Vijender Singh held the manufacturer liable after a laboratory report established that the bottle contained a foreign substance and was unsafe for consumption.The commission relied on photographs of the bottle and a report from the Food Analyst, Haryana, State Food, Water and Excise Laboratory, Chandigarh.“Sample was having black colour rubber piece whereas it should be free from the same. Hence, the sample is unsafe food,” as per the lab report noted in the order.The commission observed that the laboratory findings established that the bottle sold by the retailer contained a foreign substance and had been declared unsafe food."From the aforesaid laboratory report, it is established that the Fresca bottle sold by opposite party no.3 contained a foreign substance and was declared to be unsafe food," the bench said.It noted that the retailer had produced a bill showing that it purchased the batch from Bhatia Sons in Rohtak. However, the supplier had not been made a party to the complaint.The bench held that Fresca Foods, as the manufacturer, was responsible for the quality and safety of its product and was liable to compensate the complainant. It allowed the complaint against the manufacturer.Final orderThe commission, in its October 15, 2026, order, directed Fresca Foods to:Refund Rs 340 towards the invoice amount.Pay Rs 2,000 towards laboratory charges.Pay Rs 15,000 as compensation for mental agony and harassment.Pay Rs 5,000 towards litigation costs.The manufacturer must comply within 30 days of receiving the order. If it fails to do so, it will also have to pay Rs 50 per week to the complainant.The total amount payable under the order is Rs 22,340, excluding the additional weekly amount that may accrue in case of non-compliance.

articles.title: Season’s Greetings: Delhi sees most polluted day after Dussehra in 5 years, GRAP invoked
articles.summary: Delhi AQI hits 245 after Dussehra, worst in 5 years; CAQM invokes GRAP Stage I with BS-VI bus curbs, DG set limits, and added Metro trips.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Delhi’s air quality deteriorated to poor for the first time this season as the AQI climbed to 245 Wednesday. It was 179 a day earlier.Delhi also saw the most polluted day after Dussehra in the last five years. An AQI higher than Wednesday’s was last recorded in 2021, when it was 284 the day after Dussehra.The air quality worsened due to unfavourable meteorological conditions and additional emissions from firecrackers that were burst during Dussehra celebrations. The contribution of stubble burning to Delhi’s PM2.5 was 3.9% Wednesday.The deterioration in air quality prompted Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) to invoke Stage I of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP).This includes a ban on the entry of intercity and inter-state buses from Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Uttarakhand and J&K that are below BS-VI standards and run on neither electricity nor CNG. Regulations on the use of diesel generator (DG) sets also kicked in.GRAP Stage I also asks for augmenting public transport through CNG and electric buses, metro and RRTS services by inducting an additional fleet and increasing the frequency of service. Delhi Metro will run 20 additional trips from Thursday onwards for all weekdays.“The forecast by India Meteorological Department and Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology has also predicted that AQI will remain in the poor category in the coming days,” CAQM said.The commission added that actions under Stage I of GRAP will be implemented, monitored and reviewed by all the agencies in NCR to ensure that the AQI does not rise further.Central Pollution Control Board’s data shows that air quality showed a rising trend since early Wednesday. The AQI was 227 at 7am and touched 245 at 4pm, when CPCB releases its 24-hour average AQI bulletin. It increased to 248 at 8pm.This year, a higher AQI than 245 was last witnessed on July 24 at 246 in the poor category when dust travelled from Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan towards north-west India.The AQI was in the very poor category at seven locations Wednesday -- Pusa (329), Chandni Chowk (326), Jahangirpuri (313), Punjabi Bagh (312), Patparganj (304), Mandir Marg (303) and Vivek Vihar (302).Mahesh Palawat, vice-president of Skymet Meteorology, said the worsening air quality could be attributed to the Dussehra celebrations, including the burning of the Ravana effigies.“Falling night temperatures and light winds may have further contributed to the deterioration.... Traffic emissions, industrial smoke and dust tend to accumulate under such conditions, while fireworks during the celebrations may also have contributed to the overnight rise in pollution. The haze observed Wednesday followed Tuesday’s celebrations,” he said.The Decision Support System (DSS), which functions under the Union ministry of earth sciences, has estimated that the contribution of stubble burning to Delhi’s pollution could rise to 7.4% Thursday, 15.9% Friday and 4.1% Saturday.Sunil Dahiya, founder of the think tank Envirocatalyst, said: “The slow moving wind coming from the northwest, bringing more emission load from farm fires and festive emission load, Tuesday evening to night,” had added to other regional sources as well as emissions from within Delhi.In Oct last year, the AQI worsened to poor on Oct 14. It was 211. It deteriorated to very poor by Oct 20 at 345 last year.Delhi Traffic Police has urged commuters to reduce vehicular emissions. articles.title: Armed federal agents knock on doors looking for noncitizen voters
articles.summary: Armed and in uniform, agents from the Department of Homeland Security have been knocking on doors to ask residents about their immigration status whether the...
articles.body:
Armed and in uniform, federal agents from the Department of Homeland Security have been knocking on doors in several states to ask residents about their immigration status — and to inquire if they have registered to vote or cast votes in past elections, a CBS News Investigation has found.

The operation is part of an effort to root out potential noncitizen voters ahead of the midterms. DHS has alleged that there could be as many as 250,000 citizens illegally registered to vote, although election experts have disputed the accuracy of this figure. Just 156 people have been charged with voting-fraud related offenses since the beginning of the Trump administration, according to the Department of Justice. There are 227 million registered voters in the U.S.

Critics say that sending armed federal agents to the doors of U.S. residents could be intimidating for legal voters.

"What we're seeing now is the federal government is inserting itself into the state process for verifying their voter roles in an unprecedented way," said Jessica Marsden, a lawyer for Protect Democracy, a left-leaning advocacy group that is suing the federal agency over the door-knocking campaign. "And they are doing it in a way that seems maximally designed to scare lawful voters from participating."

The home visits ramped up in September, in the thick of the midterm campaign season, and continued over the past weekend. The Justice Department announced Monday that Homeland Security agents in California arrested more than 20 people , all of them green card holders , on allegations they had illegally registered or cast a vote.

As part of that roundup, dozens of federal agents descended on the residence of a 72-year-old man from Belize, who was taken from his home in his pajamas and arrested on charges he allegedly voted illegally in the past four elections.

"HSI is actively rooting out and investigating election fraud wherever it can be found," said a DHS spokesperson. "Under President Trump, HSI is committed to restoring integrity to our election systems and ensuring that American citizens and only American citizens are electing American leaders."

Eric Balliet, a former Homeland Security Investigations agent, said the door-knocking operation is a significant departure from traditional law enforcement activities.

"In my 23 years with HSI, I never engaged in or was aware of any incident or initiative that sent Special Agents to private residences to verify the eligibility of voters," Balliet said, who served in the federal government under multiple administrations.

In June, the DHS directed U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, or ICE, to assist in deportations of alleged noncitizen voters. Homeland Security Investigations, the agency conducting the at-home visits, is one of the enforcement arms of ICE and typically focuses on criminal cross border investigations like child exploitation, drug smuggling and money laundering.

Months later after the announcement, hundreds of agents were pulled off their cases and assigned to track down alleged noncitizen voters as part of a "surge" initiative, according to internal documents reviewed by CBS News. The directive, first reported by CNN , describes a "Criminal Voter Fraud " initiative that includes "field reviews" in at least six states including California, Georgia, Missouri, Pennsylvania, Washington and Wisconsin.

Photos and videos posted on X show agents from Homeland Security Investigations, some of whom are carrying firearms , approaching houses and knocking on doors, under captions like, "AMERICAN ELECTIONS ARE FOR AMERICANS."

One photo from Kansas City HSI's account shows four agents at the door of a woman standing on her porch holding a child's hand.

The woman is identified in a Department of Justice press release as Mariana Alexandra Dewey, a Peruvian national who was charged with four counts of voter-fraud related crimes including illegally casting a ballot in the 2024 election. Her case has not yet been heard. Her lawyer declined to respond to CBS News' request for comment.

Hours after this article was published, Democratic Rep. Bennie Thompson, the ranking member of the Homeland Security Committee, wrote to DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin to demand the that DHS immediately cease "law enforcement activity aimed at intimidating the public as the 2026 midterm elections are underway." He said the DHS operations "reflect an anti-democratic departure from the mission Congress set for the Department, and serve only President Trump's voter suppression agenda, not a legitimate enforcement objective."

For civil rights advocates, the show of force has sparked concerns about the chilling effect it could have on legal voters.

"It is sending the signal to a much broader community, do not show up at the polls. Do not vote," said Dr. Carol Anderson, a professor of African American Studies at Emory University.

"And so if you are somebody who has registered to vote and you're a naturalized citizen, what you see in that community is that — because this is not a regime that makes those discernments — that you're gonna stay away from the voting booth."

A DHS spokesperson said, "DHS and DOJ are laser focused on prosecuting and removing aliens who vote and preventing the dilution of the votes of U.S. citizens… Those who are here legally and are not breaking other laws have nothing to fear."

In one video, agents are filmed holding a document that says, " Target List ."

That list can be far reaching, said a HSI agent familiar with the initiative who asked to speak anonymously. DHS pulls from internal databases, voter rolls, and other datasets. Then employees attempt to match names against citizenship data provided by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services, or USCIS.

In September, a USCIS whistleblower said that employees were asked to review the voter information of tens of thousands of individuals across the country, including citizens. Employees were given quotas to investigate 40 subjects a day, which is a rate of roughly 12 minutes per subject.

DHS has defended the data matching program and the work USCIS has done to identify potential noncitizen voters.

"Far from being rushed or untrained, these investigative efforts are conducted diligently and professionally," said a DHS spokesperson. "There is no quota on criminality. DHS will pursue each and every illegal voter to the fullest extent of the law ."

"There's every reason to expect that there are many, many more false positives in these lists," said Marsden.

She noted that Homeland Security officials initially said they had identified nearly 16,000 noncitizens on Nevada's voter rolls, but ultimately they were unable to provide evidence of a single illegally registered voter.

articles.title: Bishnoi gang link, Rs 2 lakh trail: Inside probe into Tiger Shroff attack case
articles.summary: Mumbai Police arrest three more in Tiger Shroff firing case, taking total to 10; Lawrence Bishnoi gang’s Shubham Lonkar named key conspirator.
articles.body: MUMBAI: The city crime branch on Wednesday arrested three more people in the case of firing at actor Tiger Shroff even as wanted criminal Shubham Lonkar of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang has allegedly emerged as a key executor of the plot.The total number of persons arrested in the case has now touched 10, including two women.The police are also probing if the accused had conducted reconnaissance of other Bollywood celebrities’ homes or whether Shroff was the only target.Lonkar’s name cropped up first in the city in the Oct 2024 killing of former NCP minister Baba Siddique in which he was alleged to have assembled shooters, supplied weapons and arranged finance.Lonkar’s brother Praveen is in jail in the Siddique murder case and the firing at Salman Khan’s house in April 2024.Another key figure who has become the centre of the probe is Sameer, a garment shop owner from Sonipat, who coordinated with the shooters, police said.He was allegedly responsible for providing logistical support to the shooters. Police said that he stayed in Mumbai with the other accused and assisted them before returning from the city prior to the shooting.Preliminary ballistic reports have suggested the shooters used two country-made firearms which are yet to be recovered. The three accused shooters—Phool Singh (18), Rehan Ansari (18), and Rithik Mahtoo alias Roshan (22)—who were arrested from Kota were produced before the 37th Metropolitan Magistrate Court which remanded them to police custody till Oct 31.Police, while seeking police custody of the accused, told the court that the accused have destroyed the mobile phones used in connection with the crime, making the reconstruction of their communications through social media apps a key part of the investigation.Police are attempting to establish contact between the shooters and their alleged handlers through other digital evidence and their interrogation.The shooters had arrived in Mumbai on Sept 20, police said. “So far, investigation suggests the shooters and those who provided logistic support received around Rs 2 lakh, with which they bought a second-hand bike for Rs 25,000. Another Rs 37,000 was transferred in the account of Rehan Ansari. There were some more cash payments which are being ascertained,” said Raj Tilak Roshan, deputy commissioner of police. Investigators are also examining the payments made through UPI applications and cash.Ansari and Singh’s lawyer, Ajinkya Mirgal, argued that the police have already interrogated them in two days’ transit remand and they should be sent to judicial custody.According to the preliminary investigation, Anil Pandit allegedly contacted Sameer, who in turn allegedly contacted Ansari.Ansari is suspected of having brought together Phool Singh and Hrithik alias Roshan, the two accused alleged to have carried out the firing at Shroff.The five others, including two women, who have been arrested allegedly played roles in procuring, transporting and supplying weapons to the shooters and providing logistical support to the group. One of them, Radha, a bar dancer, was a friend of accused Kunal.The duo came to Mumbai along with Babita, another accused. While Kunal left Mumbai the same day, the two women stayed in an Andheri lodge, delivered the weapons, and left later. articles.title: Teacher who survived Bend shooting tried to close door, ‘but the shooter was already there’
articles.summary: Becky Drury was shot and seriously wounded by the gunman, who killed three children and another teacher at Silver Rail Elementary School in Oregon.
articles.body:
A teacher who was shot by a teenage gunman in a Bend, Oregon, elementary school last week said she saw the attacker and tried to shut the classroom door, "but the shooter was already there."

Becky Drury said she was shot at close range in the rampage at Silver Rail Elementary School on Thursday.

"Lying on the floor, I saw that my left hand was almost completely severed from the gunshot, and my other arm was also severely injured," Drury said in a statement Wednesday.

"I could not get up, defend myself, or protect anyone else," she said. "So, I did the only thing I could do, which was to pretend to be dead in the hope he would not shoot me again."

Three children, ages 5, 8 and 11, and a 25-year-old teacher were killed in the attack, which began around 1 p.m., officials said.

The gunman was fatally shot by a bystander who saw him fire at a truck and enter the school, police have said. The bystander followed the 16-year-old gunman and shot him as another teacher was wrestling with him over the weapon, according to police.

The motive remained under investigation Wednesday.

Investigators are looking into whether the shooter viewed any extremist material online, including material associated with "nihilistic violent extremism," also known as NVE, two senior law enforcement officials briefed on the investigation told NBC News.

The gun was purchased legally, Bend police said in a statement Wednesday.

Police have said that it was a Maverick 88 pump-action 12-gauge shotgun and that the shooter used birdshot, buckshot and slugs.

Police have not said who purchased the gun. Two senior law enforcement officials previously told NBC News that the shooter's mother bought it in August, around the time of his birthday.

"Bend Police detectives continue this complex investigation. They have served search warrants at the shooting suspect's home, as well as on his electronic devices and his social media accounts on a variety of platforms," police said in a statement Wednesday.

"That work continues, and it takes time," the police department said.

Students in the greater Bend-La Pine Schools district returned to class Wednesday, although not at Silver Rail Elementary, where the shooting occurred.

"Through heartfelt artwork and messages of love, they are making sure every student who walks through the doors knows they are cared for, supported and loved," the district said Tuesday as it prepared to welcome most students back.

Authorities have publicly identified two of the victims who were killed, 5-year-old Rhoam Summer and teacher Megan Lambert.

Drury, the wounded teacher, said in her statement that she heard a noise last week and went to investigate.

"Here is what I remember: Once I realized something was happening outside, I ran to see what was going on," she said.

"I then saw the shooter and immediately ran back into the classroom. I turned to shut the door behind me, but the shooter was already there," she said.

Drury said that there was nothing more she could have done and that "I was shot before I had any chance to act."

"What happened in that classroom was unimaginable, and like so many in this community, my heart is broken for everyone affected by this tragedy," she said.

"My thoughts are with those who were hurt, those we lost, their families, our school, and the Bend community," she said. "I am truly grateful for the kindness and support we have received as we face the difficult days ahead together."

articles.title: Texturas transformam paredes em elementos de destaque nos projetos  | G1
articles.standfirst: Revestimentos com relevos e diferentes formatos ajudam a criar paredes com mais identidade e expressão.
articles.summary: Revestimentos com relevos e diferentes formatos ajudam a criar paredes com mais identidade e expressão.
articles.body:
As paredes estão ganhando novas funções nos projetos de interiores. Além de delimitar os ambientes e receber cores, elas passaram a participar de forma mais ativa da composição, explorando relevos, volumes, pequenos formatos e superfícies inspiradas em elementos naturais.

Essa tendência aparece tanto em salas e quartos quanto em lavabos, banheiros e áreas gourmet. A escolha pode partir de uma parede inteira ou de uma aplicação pontual, dependendo da proposta do espaço. Em ambientes com muitos elementos, uma superfície de textura mais discreta pode complementar a composição. Já em projetos de base mais neutra, relevos pronunciados e formas orgânicas conseguem assumir maior protagonismo.

Relevos modificam a percepção das paredes ao criar volumes, sombras e diferentes efeitos ao longo do dia — Foto: Acervo Vilarejo

Nos revestimentos com relevo, a percepção da superfície muda conforme o ponto de observação e a incidência de luz. Durante o dia, a entrada de luz natural pode destacar determinadas partes do desenho e criar sombras suaves. À noite, a posição e a temperatura da iluminação artificial produzem outra leitura da mesma parede. Por isso, observar uma amostra sob diferentes condições antes da escolha ajuda a entender melhor como o material poderá se comportar no ambiente.

Os pequenos formatos exploram essa característica de outra maneira. A repetição das peças, o desenho das juntas e a paginação criam ritmo e permitem delimitar áreas específicas, como fundos de bancada, painéis, nichos e paredes de destaque. Peças orgânicas acrescentam ainda outra possibilidade ao fugir das linhas predominantemente retas encontradas nos formatos tradicionais.

A textura ganha diferentes leituras conforme a incidência de luz, acrescentando profundidade à superfície sem depender de mudanças estruturais no ambiente — Foto: Acervo Vilarejo

Textura também é uma escolha de equilíbrio

Criar uma parede de destaque não significa preencher o ambiente de informação. Quando o revestimento possui volume, cor ou desenho marcante, os demais materiais podem assumir uma presença mais discreta. Essa relação permite que a textura encontre espaço para aparecer sem competir com mobiliário, piso e outros elementos da composição.

Na hora da escolha, observar o material fora do expositor também faz diferença.

Nas mesas de especificação da Vilarejo, diferentes condições de luz ajudam a visualizar como tonalidades, relevos e acabamentos podem mudar de percepção. A comparação permite avaliar não apenas a cor da superfície, mas também as sombras e volumes criados pelo material antes da definição do projeto.

A parede deixa, assim, de ser apenas o plano onde a decoração acontece. Com a textura certa e uma aplicação bem planejada, ela própria passa a construir a atmosfera do espaço, mudando de aparência conforme a luz percorre o ambiente durante o dia.

A Rede Anhanguera realiza nesta quinta-feira (22) o debate do 2º turno das eleições para o governo do Tocantins.

O encontro será realizado nos estúdios da Rede Anhanguera, em Palmas , a partir das 22h, com mediação da jornalista Jocyelma Santana.

articles.title: Integrante da Bamor sugeriu apagar mensagens para evitar denúncia | G1
articles.standfirst: Relatório revela preocupação de suspeitos com possíveis provas das agressões. Em outra conversa, presidente da torcida orientou que envolvidos atribuíssem a responsabilidade pelos crimes à diretoria.
articles.summary: Relatório revela preocupação de suspeitos com possíveis provas das agressões. Presidente orientou que envolvidos atribuíssem a responsabilidade pelos crimes à diretoria.
articles.body:
Um integrante da Bamor, maior torcida organizada do Bahia, sugeriu apagar conversas de um grupo de WhatsApp para evitar que mensagens fossem utilizadas como provas após sessões de tortura que teriam sido realizadas na sede da entidade, em Salvador .

A orientação foi identificada em um relatório do Ministério Público da Bahia (MP-BA), que investiga a participação de membros da diretoria nos crimes.

“Melhor apagar tudo essas por aí, viu? Essas paradas aí porque, querendo ou não, vai que essa desgraça denuncia aí, sei lá. […] Inclusive apagar esse grupo aqui as conversa”, afirmou o integrante em uma mensagem de áudio.

O diálogo foi encontrado em um celular apreendido durante a Operação Inquisição , realizada em 28 de setembro, que resultou na prisão de 10 pessoas , entre elas o presidente da torcida, Matheus Pires Castro, e o vice-presidente, Luciano da Silva Venâncio.

Segundo as investigações, dois homens foram submetidos a sessões de tortura física e psicológica na sede da Bamor, no bairro de Nazaré, nos dias 17 e 18 de julho deste ano .

Em 2 de outubro, o MP-BA denunciou os 10 por crimes como organização criminosa, tortura, roubo, extorsão e ameaça.

As vítimas foram convocadas sob o pretexto de prestar esclarecimentos sobre supostas irregularidades financeiras envolvendo o sistema de gestão de associados da entidade. As agressões teriam durado cerca de quatro horas em cada episódio.

O relatório do MP-BA, obtido pelo g1 e pela TV Bahia, mostra que os investigados não apenas discutiram a possibilidade de excluir registros das conversas, como também demonstraram preocupação com a identificação dos responsáveis pelas agressões.

As mensagens foram trocadas no grupo “Diretoria Bamor”, composto por 19 participantes, após dois homens serem submetidos a sessões de tortura física e psicológica.

A sugestão de apagar as mensagens partiu de um interlocutor identificado como “Kakaroto Drt”, apelido associado a Ricardo Henrique Almeida da Silva, diretor de marketing da Bamor e um dos denunciados pelo MP-BA . Na gravação, Ricardo demonstrou receio de que a vítima denunciasse o ocorrido e sugeriu a exclusão dos registros, incluindo o histórico do próprio grupo de WhatsApp.

A preocupação, no entanto, não foi compartilhada por todos os participantes da conversa. O integrante identificado como Daniel, diretor da sede da Bamor, respondeu que não havia motivo para temer a existência de provas. Na mesma mensagem, ele admitiu que a vítima havia sido agredida pelo grupo.

“Não tem negócio de prova não, mano, provar o quê, véi? A gente pegou ele 'mermo', mano, que ele é ladrão, 'tava' roubando a torcida, então a gente meteu a desgraça nele e já foi”, afirmou.

Em outra mensagem, um dos investigados chegou a dizer que a vítima deveria ter sido morta. As declarações foram registradas após as agressões e fazem parte do material analisado pelo Núcleo de Extração e Análise do MP-BA.

Presidente orientou que envolvidos não fossem identificados individualmente

A preocupação com a responsabilização dos envolvidos também aparece em mensagens enviadas pelo presidente da Bamor, Matheus Pires Castro, em 19 de julho, um dia após o segundo episódio de tortura investigado pelo MP-BA.

Em um áudio encaminhado às 11h35, Matheus orientou os integrantes a atribuírem as agressões à diretoria da torcida, sem apontar quem havia praticado cada ato.

“Mas é isso, irmão, deixa eu te falar: 'cê' tem que falar que quem pegou foi a diretoria, não foi A, B, nem C, não. Teve facada? Teve. Quem foi que deu? A diretoria. Teve tiro? Teve. Quem deu? A diretoria. […] Tudo que a gente faz aqui é a diretoria. Não existe a pessoa física, não, entendeu?”.

Na sequência, o presidente reforçou que todos deveriam manter a mesma versão sobre os episódios. "(...) Não é A, nem B. Porque isso aí que gera uma briga pessoal, isso aí que cria tumulto", afirmou.

Celular de vítima também foi discutido em conversas

Outro trecho do relatório mostra que integrantes da torcida discutiram como manter acesso às mensagens de um celular que, segundo a interpretação dos investigadores, pertenceria a outra pessoa.

Em 18 de julho, às 8h26, outro participante orientou Matheus Pires Castro a desligar a conexão de internet do aparelho. “Desliga o wi-fi pq já já ele recupera o chip”, escreveu.

Em seguida, explicou que a recuperação do número telefônico poderia impedir que os integrantes continuassem acessando as conversas. “E quando ele colocar em outro celular você vai perder o acesso as conversas aí [...] Se tiver sem internet, o WhatsApp segue aberto”, afirmou.

Integrante afirmou ter quebrado braço de vítima

Uma das mensagens que constam no relatório foi enviada às 9h41 do dia 18 de julho, por "Kakaroto Drt", já identificado como o diretor de marketing Ricardo Henrique Almeida da Silva. Ao responder a uma mensagem de outro integrante, "Daniel", Ricardo afirmou: "Só me arrependi de não bater mais. Mas um braço deixei quebrado".

Na sequência, o integrante sugeriu que a análise de um celular poderia revelar outras supostas irregularidades. "Se cavar aí, acha mais coisa nesse celular. Nós pega mais ratos", diz o trecho.

Logo depois, às 9h42, os participantes continuaram comentando as agressões. Em uma das gravações, um interlocutor identificado como "Mts", associado ao presidente da torcida, Matheus Pires Castro, mencionou a utilização de uma barra durante o episódio.

"Rapaz, Piton pegou aquela barra ali, mano. Na hora que ele levantou, rapaz, pensei que ele fosse arrancar o teto".

O diálogo é apontado pelo Ministério Público como uma referência às agressões praticadas contra uma das vítimas. As conversas também trazem referências a uma faca.

Presidente ameaçou repetir tortura e arrancar membros

Matheus Pires Castro, presidente da Bamor, maior torcida organizada do Bahia, é um dos presos — Foto: Reprodução/Redes Sociais

Ainda em 19 de julho, às 11h38, Matheus Castro enviou novos áudios ao grupo. Nas gravações, afirmou que o caso de "Binho", apelido usado para se referir a uma das vítimas, estava encerrado, mas ameaçou aplicar punições ainda mais violentas caso surgissem novas suspeitas de desvios financeiros.

"Quem a gente pegar roubando agora vai ser pior do que foi com Binho. [...] Se for preciso, a gente vai arrancar uma mão, vai arrancar um pé", diz a mensagem.

Em outra gravação, o presidente afirmou que a diretoria assumia as agressões e que a vítima havia sido expulsa da torcida.

"A gente fez isso aí mesmo, acabou. Entendeu? Quem não gostar, vai lá na sede. [...] Binho tá expulso, Binho roubou e pronto".

As declarações sobre supostos desvios financeiros representam acusações feitas pelos próprios integrantes da torcida e não comprovam que a vítima tenha cometido qualquer irregularidade .

O relatório também registra uma ameaça posterior atribuída a Matheus, após comentários da vítima sobre a duração da tortura. Em um áudio, ele afirmou que, caso houvesse um novo episódio, as agressões durariam o dobro do tempo.

"Avisa a ele que se não aprender, próxima vez é 8 horas, viu? Não vão ser 4 não, vão ser 8!", indica mensagem de Matheus.

"Vamos pegar até uns alicates para a gente arrancar as unhas dele". A frase faz parte de áudios gravados por Matheus Pires Castro , presidente da Bamor, e enviados a diretores e integrantes do grupo. Nas mensagens, ele convocava pessoas para sessões de tortura física e psicológica. (Confira áudio no início da matéria)

Em uma das gravações, Matheus Castro afirmou que quem tivesse nojo de sangue não deveria comparecer ao local. Em outra, ele disse que uma das vítimas precisava apanhar para servir de exemplo. As mensagens também mostram o presidente minimizando o risco de consequências policiais e ameaçando provocar ferimentos graves.

Nas gravações, o presidente da Bamor falou sobre as agressões que pretendia promover e tentou afastar integrantes que demonstrassem receio de participar das sessões de violência.

Em um dos trechos, ele minimizou a possibilidade de consequências para os envolvidos: "Porra nenhuma, meu irmão, que nada. Vai dar porra nenhuma, irmão".

Marcas nas costas de uma das vítimas — Foto: Reprodução/TV Bahia

O presidente também orientou que integrantes contrários às agressões não compareçam à reunião e afirmou que a vítima deveria sair do local com ferimentos graves.

"Então, quem for amigo, quem ficar com pena, quem falar que pode dar merda porque a família pode correr atrás, que pode dar polícia, nem vá para a reunião. Deixa que quem quiser resolve, entendeu? Porque amanhã ele vai ter que sair com a mão esmagada para, de lá, ele fazer cirurgia. Tem que se foder e apanhar mesmo para servir de exemplo".

Em outro áudio, ele fez referência à possibilidade de uma cena violenta:

"Amanhã a gente vai pegar ele daquele jeito. Quem tiver nojo de sangue não vá, porque a gente vai pegar ele e vai ser uma cena triste para ficar de exemplo".

Em uma das falas mais explícitas, ameaçou provocar um ferimento na cabeça da vítima: "A gente vai abrir logo a cabeça dele lá no meio, essa desgraça".

A defesa de Matheus Pires e Luciano Venâncio, vice-presidente da Bamor, declarou em nota "que seus clientes são inocentes" e que "todas as medidas judiciais já estão sendo adotadas" .

Suspeitos foram denunciados pelo MP-BA — Foto: Reprodução/TV Bahia

Em 2 de outubro, o Ministério Público denunciou os 10 investigados. Os denunciados são:

Matheus Pires Castro, presidente da Bamor;

Luciano da Silva Venâncio, vice-presidente;

Ricardo Henrique Almeida da Silva, diretor de marketing;

Diego Allan Conceição Sacramento, diretor de patrimônio;

Ivã Cleiton de Jesus Santos, diretor de bateria;

Luiz Wagner da Silva Santana, diretor de sede;

Alan Rafael Regis Alves de Aquino, diretor financeiro;

Fernando Santana Esquivel, policial militar apontado como integrante da torcida organizada.

Segundo a promotora de Justiça Thelma Leal, do MP-BA, todos os integrantes presos teriam participado das agressões, embora em diferentes graus.

"O presidente e o vice estão presos. Todos participaram ativamente dos atos de tortura, de alguma forma, com maior ou menor proporção. Os relatos das vítimas dão conta que todos que estão presos participaram", afirmou.

A promotora ressaltou que as prisões atingiram integrantes da cúpula da torcida e disse esperar que a entidade passe por uma mudança de liderança e adote medidas para evitar novos episódios de violência.

articles.body:
Allyson e Cadu de Lula disputam segundo turno no RN — Foto: Inter TV Cabugi

A Inter TV promove nesta quinta-feira (22) um debate com os candidatos que disputam o segundo turno das Eleições 2026 para o governo do Rio Grande do Norte.

O evento será nos estúdios da Inter TV em Natal , com transmissão também pelo Globoplay e pelo g1 . A mediação será da jornalista Emmily Virgílio.

O debate começa por volta das 22h35, logo após a novela "Quem ama, cuida".

O debate com os candidatos ao governo do Rio Grande do Norte poderá ser acompanhado pelo sinal aberto da Inter TV Cabugi e pelo Globoplay , para os espectadores que estão no estado.

O público de qualquer outro lugar do país ou do exterior poderá acompanhar também a transmissão ao vivo no g1 RN .

Participam do debate os dois candidatos que disputam o segundo turno das Eleições 2026 para o governo do Rio Grande do Norte.

O debate será baseado em perguntas entre os candidatos com ênfase no aprofundamento do plano de governo de cada um. O debate tem duração prevista de 1 hora e 40 minutos, podendo se estender - qualquer alteração no tempo será informada na transmissão.

No primeiro bloco , os candidatos fazem perguntas um para o outro com tema livre.

No segundo bloco , os candidatos fazem perguntas entre eles sobre temas determinados pela Inter TV e sorteados ao vivo pela mediadora. Cada tema só pode ser sorteado uma vez.

No terceiro bloco , os candidatos voltam a fazer perguntas de um para o outro com tema livre .

No quarto e último bloco, os candidatos fazem novamente perguntas sobre temas determinados pela Inter TV e, depois, partem para as considerações finais - a ordem foi definida por sorteio.

➡️ Nos blocos de tema livre (1º e 3º blocos), cada candidato possui 10 minutos para debater e administrar seu tempo livremente.

➡️ Nos blocos de tema determinado (2º e 4º blocos), cada candidato tem 5 minutos por tema para debater e gerir seu tempo livremente.

➡️ A ordem de início dos blocos foi definida por sorteio: Allyson abre o 1º bloco, e Cadu de Lula inicia automaticamente o 3º bloco - os dois são de temas livres. O mesmo ocorre com os temas determinados: Allyson abre o 2º bloco e Cadu de Lula pergunta primeiro no 4º bloco.

O tempo será no formato de administração livre pelo candidato:

nos blocos de tema livre , cada candidato dispõe de um banco de 10 minutos por bloco;

nos blocos de tema determinado , cada candidato dispõe de 5 minutos por tema;

nas considerações finais , cada candidato terá 1 minuto e 30 segundos.

➡️ Os candidatos podem se movimentar livremente pelo cenário enquanto expõem ideias ao longo do debate, mas não podem se tocar durante o programa.

➡️ O candidato que estiver com a palavra não pode ser interrompido. Em caso de insistência, os microfones serão cortados para que a mediadora restabeleça a ordem.

Os pedidos de direito de resposta serão analisados pela produção caso ocorra ofensa pessoal no campo moral, podendo ser concedido 1 minuto para resposta. Para solicitar, o candidato ofendido deve levantar a mão em silêncio no momento da ofensa e aguardar ser notado pela mediadora

Em caso de ausência de um dos candidatos, será realizada uma entrevista de 25 minutos com o candidato que comparecer.

Os temas das perguntas serão os mesmos que seriam usados nos blocos de tema determinado e serão sorteados da urna.

articles.title: Outubro marca uma etapa decisiva para obras e reformas de fim de ano | G1
articles.standfirst: Organização do cronograma e definição antecipada dos materiais ajudam a manter o andamento da obra nos últimos meses do ano.
articles.summary: Organização do cronograma e definição antecipada dos materiais ajudam a manter o andamento da obra nos últimos meses do ano.
articles.body:
Os últimos meses do ano costumam mudar o ritmo de quem está construindo ou reformando. Com a aproximação das férias escolares e datas festivas, as decisões que poderiam ser adiadas passam a exigir mais atenção, principalmente quando diferentes profissionais e serviços dependem uns dos outros para avançar. É o momento de revisar o que já foi executado, identificar as próximas etapas e definir quais materiais serão necessários para dar continuidade ao projeto.

Ter um cronograma organizado ajuda a estabelecer essa ordem. Assentamento de pisos e revestimentos, instalação de bancadas, pintura e colocação de louças e metais possuem momentos específicos dentro da obra. Quando essas etapas são planejadas em conjunto, fica mais fácil evitar interferências entre serviços, compras de última hora e mudanças que podem gerar retrabalho.

A definição antecipada dos materiais ajuda a organizar as próximas etapas e evita que decisões importantes fiquem concentradas na reta final da obra — Foto: Acervo Vilarejo

A ordem das compras também deve acompanhar o cronograma. Pisos e revestimentos precisam ter medidas e quantidades conferidas antes do assentamento, considerando paginação, recortes e possíveis perdas. Nas etapas seguintes, a atenção passa para outros elementos. Bancadas precisam estar compatíveis com as cubas escolhidas, enquanto louças e metais devem considerar dimensões, pontos hidráulicos e características de instalação.

Antecipar essas definições permite ainda verificar a disponibilidade dos materiais antes de cada serviço começar. Quando o produto está em estoque, o recebimento pode ser programado de acordo com o avanço da obra, evitando que uma equipe chegue à etapa de instalação enquanto uma escolha importante ainda está pendente.

A disponibilidade dos materiais permite programar compras e recebimentos de acordo com as próximas etapas previstas no cronograma — Foto: Acervo Vilarejo

Com mais de 350 mil metros quadrados de revestimentos em estoque, além de louças, metais, tintas e outros acabamentos, a Vilarejo reúne produtos para diferentes momentos da construção e da reforma. As entregas frequentes também permitem organizar o recebimento conforme a necessidade de cada etapa, sem concentrar todos os materiais no canteiro de uma única vez.

Esse cuidado ganha importância nos últimos meses do ano. Definir com antecedência o que será utilizado nas próximas fases permite que profissionais e moradores tenham uma visão mais clara do que ainda precisa ser comprado, instalado ou finalizado. Também reduz a necessidade de tomar decisões importantes enquanto outros serviços já estão acontecendo.

Ganhar tempo não significa acelerar todas as frentes ao mesmo tempo. Significa reduzir decisões pendentes. Outubro pode ser o momento de colocar o cronograma no papel, confirmar os materiais das próximas etapas e organizar os recebimentos para que cada serviço avance no momento previsto.

articles.summary: Foram convidados os candidatos Lorenzo Pazolini (Republicanos) e Ricardo Ferraço (MDB), que disputam o segundo turno para o governo do ES; debate começa a partir das 22h30
articles.body:
Debate para governo do ES no 2º turno entre Lorenzo Pazolini e Ricardo Ferraço — Foto: Reprodução

A TV Gazeta promove nesta quinta-feira (22) o debate entre os candidatos que disputam o segundo turno do governo do Espírito Santo. O encontro será realizado na sede da Rede Gazeta, em Vitória, com transmissão ao vivo pela TV Gazeta , pelo g1 e pelo Globoplay, a partir das 22h30.

Foram convidados os dois candidatos que disputam o segundo turno ao governo do Espírito Santo: Lorenzo Pazolini (Republicanos) e Ricardo Ferraço (MDB). A mediação será feita pela jornalista Rafaela Marquezini.

O público poderá acompanhar o debate ao vivo pelos seguintes canais e plataformas:

g1: transmissão simultânea e íntegra disponível após o debate.

TV Gazeta: após a novela Quem Ama Cuida.

Globoplay: debate completo disponível após a exibição.

O debate será dividido em quatro blocos, com perguntas entre os candidatos e foco na discussão de propostas e programas de governo. Serão dois blocos com temas livres e dois com temas determinados.

A direção de Jornalismo da TV Gazeta apresentou as regras na segunda (19). Apenas a campanha do governador Ricardo Ferraço (MDB) enviou um representante para a reunião. Lorenzo Pazolini (Republicanos) não compareceu nem enviou integrante da equipe.

Os blocos serão organizados da seguinte forma:

2º bloco : perguntas com tema determinado;

4º bloco : perguntas com tema determinado e considerações finais.

Nos blocos de tema livre, cada candidato terá 13 minutos para administrar como quiser. Já nos blocos de tema determinado, cada um terá quatro minutos para debater cada assunto.

Os temas serão escolhidos pelos candidatos entre seis opções definidas pelo Jornalismo da TV Gazeta e colocadas em uma urna. Cada tema poderá ser escolhido apenas uma vez.

Lorenzo Pazolini (Podemos) e Ricardo Ferraço (MDB) participam de debate na TV Gazeta — Foto: A Gazeta

A ordem de abertura dos blocos será definida por sorteio. O candidato que começar o primeiro bloco será o segundo a iniciar o terceiro. Já o candidato que abrir o segundo bloco será o segundo a fazer a primeira pergunta no quarto.

Nas considerações finais, cada candidato terá um minuto e 30 segundos, em ordem definida por sorteio.

Durante o programa, os candidatos poderão circular livremente pelo cenário. Eles poderão se cumprimentar com um aperto de mão no início e no fim do debate, mas não poderão se tocar durante o programa.

O candidato que estiver com a palavra não poderá ser interrompido. Caso haja insistência, os microfones poderão ser cortados para que o mediador restabeleça a ordem. As câmeras também poderão mostrar os dois candidatos simultaneamente durante perguntas e respostas.

Caso um candidato faça ofensas pessoais ao adversário, o candidato ofendido poderá solicitar direito de resposta levantando a mão em silêncio. A produção avaliará o pedido e poderá conceder um minuto para a resposta.

Se um dos candidatos não comparecer, será realizada uma entrevista de 25 minutos com o candidato presente. As perguntas abordarão os mesmos temas previstos para os blocos de tema determinado.

Se um candidato abandonar o debate depois do início, o programa continuará em formato de entrevista com aquele que permanecer.

articles.title: Insônia pode elevar em 40% o risco de demência; saiba como tratar | G1
articles.standfirst: Muito além do cansaço, noites mal dormidas podem comprometer a saúde do cérebro e do coração. Médicos explicam por que a insônia deve ser encarada como uma doença e não apenas como um incômodo passageiro.
articles.summary: A insônia crônica compromete a saúde cerebral e cardiovascular, aumentando o risco de doenças graves como o Alzheimer e o AVC.
articles.body:
Passar uma noite em claro pode provocar irritação, dificuldade de concentração e sonolência no dia seguinte. Mas quando o problema se torna frequente, as consequências podem ser muito mais sérias. Estudos citados por especialistas apontam que a insônia crônica está associada a um maior risco de demência, acidente vascular cerebral (AVC) e doenças cardíacas.

A preocupação cresce porque a dificuldade para dormir é mais comum do que parece. Segundo especialistas, quase um terço dos adultos que vivem nas capitais brasileiras apresenta algum sintoma de insônia, como dificuldade para pegar no sono, despertares frequentes durante a madrugada ou acordar antes do horário desejado sem conseguir voltar a dormir.

O que acontece no cérebro de quem dorme mal

Nos últimos anos, pesquisas têm ajudado a mostrar que o sono desempenha um papel fundamental na manutenção do cérebro. Durante o sono profundo, entra em ação um mecanismo responsável por eliminar resíduos e substâncias acumuladas ao longo do dia.

O processo ocorre por meio da circulação do líquor, fluido que percorre os espaços entre as células cerebrais. Durante o sono, esses espaços aumentam temporariamente, permitindo uma espécie de "faxina" no cérebro.

Quando a pessoa dorme mal por períodos prolongados, essa limpeza pode ficar comprometida. Como consequência, podem se acumular proteínas associadas a doenças neurodegenerativas, como a beta-amiloide e a tau, frequentemente relacionadas ao Alzheimer.

O neurologista Diego Carvalho afirma que o problema é resultado de um processo contínuo e não de uma única noite mal dormida.

"Diversas noites mal dormidas, sem aquela recuperação, acabam levando a uma maior tendência ao acúmulo dessas proteínas que leva à morte neuronal com o tempo", explica.

Segundo Diego Carvalho, pesquisas recentes reforçam a relação entre insônia e declínio cognitivo.

De acordo com o neurologista, um estudo da Clínica Mayo, nos Estados Unidos, indicou que pessoas com mais de 60 anos que sofrem de insônia crônica apresentam risco cerca de 40% maior de desenvolver demência nos cinco anos seguintes.

"Não é algo que acontece de uma noite para o dia. É um problema crônico e, conforme a gente envelhece, acaba ficando um pouco mais difícil de reverter", afirma o especialista.

As consequências da insônia também atingem o sistema cardiovascular.

"A insônia está associada com problemas cardiovasculares também, aumento do risco de ter um AVC, um derrame, ou de ter um problema cardíaco", diz Diego Carvalho.

Além dos riscos de longo prazo, quem convive com a doença costuma sentir os efeitos imediatamente na rotina.

É o caso de Patrick, de 35 anos, que trabalha com reabilitação física. Ele relata que o cansaço provocado pelas noites mal dormidas chegou a afetar sua atenção durante o trabalho.

"Tava com tanto cansaço que meu olho fechou na hora", conta ao lembrar de um atendimento em que um paciente quase caiu após um momento de exaustão.

A artista plástica e designer de joias Vitória, de 30 anos, também sente os efeitos da privação de sono.

"Eu me sinto fraca. Eu me sinto como se tivesse drenado minha energia", relata.

Segundo o psiquiatra Alexandre Azevedo, do laboratório do sono da USP, a insônia deve ser investigada quando a dificuldade para dormir ocorre ao menos três vezes por semana, por um período de três meses, acompanhada de cansaço, fadiga ou prejuízo nas atividades diárias.

Nesses casos, a orientação é procurar ajuda médica. O especialista ressalta que o tratamento nem sempre envolve medicamentos.

"A medicação não vem antes das medidas comportamentais", afirma.

Entre as estratégias recomendadas estão reduzir o uso de telas antes de dormir, evitar cafeína à noite, manter horários regulares para acordar e aumentar a exposição à luz natural ao longo do dia.

Para os especialistas, a principal mensagem é que a insônia não deve ser tratada apenas como um desconforto passageiro. Quando persistente, ela pode comprometer o funcionamento do cérebro, do coração e a qualidade de vida de quem convive diariamente com noites mal dormidas.

A transmissão será ao vivo pela Rede Amazônica , pelo g1, CBN e pelo Globoplay . Foram convidados para o debate os candidatos Omar Aziz (PSD) e Professora Maria do Carmo ( PL ).

O debate integra a cobertura das eleições de 2026 realizada pela Rede Amazônica, pelo g1 e pela TV Globo . O objetivo é ampliar o espaço para a apresentação de propostas e para o confronto de ideias entre os candidatos que disputam o Governo do Amazonas.

O debate com os candidatos ao Governo do Amazonas será transmitido ao vivo pela Rede Amazônica , após a novela "Quem Ama Cuida".

articles.title: Where was Ash Dykes? Explorer’s team reveals satellite contact update after more than 16 hours without news
articles.summary: Extreme adventurer Ash Dykes has given his supporters a reason to worry after his team went more than 16 hours without hearing from him during a demanding
articles.body: Extreme adventurer Ash Dykes has given his supporters a reason to worry after his team went more than 16 hours without hearing from him during a demanding journey through the Congo Basin. The 35-year-old Welsh explorer is travelling hundreds of miles through remote waterways, where weak signals and failing equipment can make communication difficult. His support team has now confirmed contact through a satellite device, offering some relief. However, the lack of regular updates highlights the risks Dykes faces as he continues one of the most challenging expeditions of his career.Ash Dykes’ Congo Basin trek raises concerns after communication failureDykes is currently undertaking a 434-mile journey from Nola in the Central African Republic to Mossaka in the Republic of Congo. The route takes him through a remote region where access to reliable communication can be limited, leaving his support team dependent on satellite technology for updates.Concern grew on Wednesday, October 21, when a member of his team named Matt shared an update on Instagram. The message revealed that more than 16 hours had passed without contact.“ATTENTION. It’s been more than 16 hours since we last heard from Ash and the team which is concerning,” the message read. “We will endeavour to keep you posted and let you all know as soon as we hear more. Thank you.”The announcement quickly drew attention to the dangers of travelling through isolated waterways. In such areas, even a temporary loss of communication can leave families, supporters and expedition teams waiting for news without knowing what is happening on the ground.Around five hours after the initial warning, the team shared a more reassuring update. They had managed to hear from Dykes through his Garmin satellite device after his Starlink connection and power bank had run out.“There’s no way for them to send videos or updates, they can only send short messages whenever they get signal on the Garmin,” the Instagram message read.Although contact had been restored, the update made clear that regular video footage and detailed reports might remain unavailable until the team could recharge its equipment and regain a stronger connection.Ash Dykes faces major risks during Project Six expeditionThe Congo Basin journey forms part of Dykes’ wider Project Six mission, which consists of six expeditions. He has documented the physical demands and unexpected challenges of his travels through online videos, including encounters with large insects and the effort required to kayak long distances.For an explorer travelling through unfamiliar terrain, preparation is essential, but it cannot remove every risk. Equipment can fail, conditions can change quickly, and help may be far away.Dykes has previously acknowledged the uncertainty that comes with this kind of adventure. Speaking to People, he said, “There’s definitely the fear that anything can happen,” Dykes told People. “It is an adventure, and as experienced as I am, I can anticipate what might happen and try to understand, based on experience, how I usually react to those situations. I feel that I’ve got what it takes to bring us all back safe and alive.”His team's latest update offers some reassurance, but the expedition remains demanding. articles.title: AI uncovers decade-old PHP flaw: Government websites across Europe went offline amid cyberattack
articles.summary: Government websites and online services across Europe and elsewhere went offline on Wednesday after critical vulnerabilities in the widely used PHP
articles.body: Government websites and online services across Europe and elsewhere went offline on Wednesday after critical vulnerabilities in the widely used PHP programming language triggered a global security response, Reuters reported. Cybersecurity experts warned that hackers could exploit the flaws on a large scale as website operators scrambled to install emergency fixes.PHP developers released security patches on Wednesday, urging users to update immediately. Several technology firms warned that attackers were already attempting to exploit the vulnerabilities, prompting government agencies and other organisations to temporarily take websites offline as a precaution.With fixes now publicly available, experts warned that artificial intelligence tools could help hackers reverse-engineer the vulnerabilities and target unpatched systems before operators could secure them.AI was powering a "race to exploit," said Costin Raiu, co-founder of cybersecurity research and incident response firm TLP. He warned that the next stage could be the "mass compromise of every vulnerable web server on the internet."AI helps uncover decade-old vulnerabilitiesTwo cybersecurity companies, Calif and Wiz, said they had independently discovered the vulnerabilities using artificial intelligence. Calif said it identified the flaws with the help of a large language model on August 1, while Alphabet-owned Wiz said its research involved its autonomous AI vulnerability research tool, Wiz Atlas, as well as Google's Gemini 4 Argon and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol.According to Wiz, the vulnerabilities had remained hidden in PHP's codebase for more than a decade and would have been exceptionally difficult for human hackers to exploit at scale."Pre-AI, this manual work would be difficult to implement and even harder to scale," the company said in a blog post. "With AI, this is no longer a barrier."Calif and Wiz said they coordinated with each other, the PHP development team and OpenAI on the discovery. The White House said it had been informed of the vulnerability on Friday.Amazon's security chief, CJ Moses, said the company's security team detected an attempt to exploit the flaws against one of its decoy systems on October 17, four days before public disclosure. The attempt came from an anonymous internet address, and it remained unclear how the attacker had learned about the vulnerabilities while details were under embargo.Amazon said multiple actors made further attempts on Wednesday and warned that the flaws were "now being broadly exploited in the wild." It added that it was unclear whether the attempts would have succeeded against real websites.Why the PHP flaws pose a global riskPHP is a programming language used to run websites and is built into widely used platforms such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla and Magento. According to web technology tracker W3Techs, PHP runs roughly 75% of websites whose programming language can be identified."This issue impacts the majority of the internet," said Tiffany Farriss, interim chief executive of the Drupal Association. "All servers using any version of PHP released in the last 20 years will ⁠be vulnerable," she said.Data from internet intelligence firm Censys showed that about 1.5 million of the 2.6 million hosts it tracked were running PHP versions for which no fix was available.Cybersecurity agencies urged website operators to apply the patches immediately or take their websites offline until the fixes could be installed. Experts warned that smaller websites run by individuals and organisations with limited technical resources could face greater risks, particularly those using shared hosting services.Lukasz Olejnik, a visiting senior research fellow at King's College London, warned that AI-assisted hacking campaigns could cause widespread disruption if vulnerable servers remained unpatched."The scale is huge, and with AI, exploitation may happen instantly," Olejnik said.Government services taken offlineThe vulnerabilities triggered precautionary shutdowns across several European countries.In the Netherlands, the National Cyber Security Centre went offline, followed by several other organisations, including the Port of Rotterdam, government portal Overheid.nl, the national football association KNVB, websites of the country's five largest political parties and several hospital websites.Danish municipal IT company Kombit shut down several services, including the national school communication platform.In Finland, state IT services provider Valtori took government public network services offline "as a precautionary measure". France's Interior Ministry also placed all its websites under preventive maintenance.The operator of Wikipedia said it had taken an unspecified number of systems offline until they could be safely patched. The Internet Archive also briefly went offline to address the issue.Dutch Prime Minister said he was closely monitoring the situation, while Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi urged website owners to "check whether your live site uses PHP and prepare to apply the new fix."Automattic, which operates WordPress.com, said users of its hosted services and Tumblr were protected from the vulnerability.The disruption has underscored the risks posed by security flaws in widely used software, with experts warning that AI could accelerate the process of turning previously difficult-to-exploit vulnerabilities into tools for large-scale cyberattacks.You use AI every day. articles.title: 'I clean, they dirty faster': MP's Bittu Tabahi may quit cleaning river forever
articles.summary: BHOPAL: Madhya Pradesh's 20-year-old college student Surendra Singh Choudhary-better known to the country as \"Bittu Tabahi\"-is a dejected man.
articles.body: BHOPAL: Madhya Pradesh's 20-year-old college student Surendra Singh Choudhary-better known to the country as "Bittu Tabahi"-is a dejected man. Bittu, who hogged international limelight for single-handedly cleaning up a stretch of Ajnar river in Rajgarh's Biaora, says every time he cleans up the river, people dump garbage back into it-sometimes almost immediately. The situation worsened after Dussehra, when fresh waste accumulated along the banks he had worked so hard to restore."I have been working to clean this river for the past year. Every time I have cleaned it, people have dirtied it again," he said, his voice heavy with disappointment. "I am starting to lose heart.""I think I should focus on my studies," Bittu said.Bittu cleaned river stretch alone, larger civic failure is now making him fight losing battleI don't believe I will be able to continue cleaning the Ajnar river any longer."The statement marks a troubling turn for a campaign that became a symbol of individual environmental action. Bittu's central argument remains simple: removing garbage is only temporary if people continue to throw waste into the river. Lasting change, he believes, requires citizens to stop littering in the first place.Ajnar, which flows through Biaora in Rajgarh district, had long been treated as an open dumping ground. Passers-by reportedly covered their mouths with cloth to escape its stench. Bittu began cleaning a stretch of the river on Jan 26, initially with a few friends, but soon found himself working alone, armed with little more than basic tools and determination.There was no govt order, no funding and no formal campaign behind his effort. He used his own money for supplies, entered foul water despite not knowing how to swim, and removed waste bag by bag. For a while, the results were visible. The stretch Bittu cleaned became noticeably clearer, and his videos earned praise from across India and abroad.But that recognition has not stopped the river from being littered again. His frustration deepened after he installed two dustbins along the riverbank, hoping residents and visitors would dispose of waste responsibly. One of the bins later went missing. Bittu clarified that the dustbins were meant for public use, not personal convenience.During another clean-up, conducted with the local Nagar Palika team, Bittu found an Indian national flag among the waste. He used the moment to ask a question that has become central to his campaign: "When will we understand our responsibility?"Those who have followed Bittu's work describe a young volunteer whose energy was once extraordinary. He cleaned without machinery, faced health risks and snake encounters, and continued even after criticism. But repeated relapse of pollution has begun to test that resolve. Bittu's exhaustion highlights a larger civic failure. articles.title: 'Tricolor row': What happened at Priyanka Gandhi’s son Raihan’s exhibition at Bikaner House - controversy explained
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: A controversy erupted at Delhi’s Bikaner House after artist and photographer Raihan Vadra, son of Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and
articles.body: NEW DELHI: A controversy erupted at Delhi’s Bikaner House after artist and photographer Raihan Vadra, son of Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and businessman Robert Vadra, alleged that the venue’s management asked him to remove around 74 photographs documenting recent youth protests ahead of his solo exhibition, “No Idea Is Final”.Raihan also alleged that he was asked to remove two photographs of the Indian flag, saying he had refused to take them down.The exhibition opened as scheduled on Wednesday, with around 40 photographs remaining on display while more than 70 were removed, according to a PTI report. The show, featuring wildlife photography, abstract works and images of recent youth movements, is scheduled to continue until Sunday.In a post on Instagram, Raihan wrote, "Five hours ago, the Bikaner House Management forced me to remove the bulk of the artworks displayed in my show "No Idea Is Final", which opens this evening at 7 pm. The photos were of the youth protests in Delhi. Apparently, the content is "objectionable". They also directed me to remove two photos of the Tiranga. I have refused. I will not take down a picture of the Indian flag."Why were the photographs removedRaihan told PTI that the management had raised objections to the “political nature” of the protest photographs. He said he was informed at 3.30 pm on Wednesday that the images had to be removed by 5 pm or the exhibition would be cancelled.According to Raihan, the management said that, given the prevailing political climate in India, it was not the right time to display the images. He maintained that the photographs did not convey a political message and merely documented protests over the preceding six months."I felt it is my duty as an Indian artist, not just because I am doing a show right now, but it is my duty as an Indian artist to document what is going on... They are censoring the work of artists, I don't know what they are scared of. They even went to the extent of removing the picture of the Indian flag," he told PTI.Raihan also said he had shared the exhibition proposal and layout with the management well in advance and objected to the removal of nearly half the artworks less than 24 hours before the opening.A Bikaner House official told PTI that the administration was not authorised to comment on the matter.Priyanka Gandhi, Congress leaders reactPriyanka Gandhi Vadra criticised the alleged removal of the photographs, describing it as an attempt to silence young voices."I think it's ridiculous. What do you think? He is a young boy but I suppose you know, they are muzzling the voice of the youth across the nation. So it's only expected that they'll do it to anyone," she told PTI."His photographs of the protests, not a single commentary, not a single thing that was either derogatory towards anyone, just a visual documentation of the protest. So, I mean, clearly this is the way they think. It's not a democracy anymore. Today it's him, tomorrow it'll be another artist," she added.Senior Congress leader Pawan Khera also criticised the alleged censorship, questioning why photographs documenting protests had been considered objectionable."When even the Tricolour isn’t safe from the censor’s scissors, perhaps the problem isn’t the art. It’s the regime. Just hours before @raihanrvadra was to open his art show ‘No Idea Is Final ’, 74 artworks - nearly half the exhibition - were taken down for being 'political ' by the Bikaner House. The photographs merely documented protests, and not one was derogatory or inflammatory. So what exactly was the offence?" he said.Khera further alleged that a photograph of the Tricolour was among the works Raihan had to fight to retain. Congress MP Karti Chidambaram also condemned the alleged censorship, calling the administration's behaviour "obtuse" and "churlish."The Indian Youth Congress Legal Cell also reacted to the controversy, posting on X: "IYC Legal Cell's tweet: YOU CAN CENSOR THE FRAME. NOT THE TRUTH. Saheb dara hua hai (sir is scared)."Raihan said the exhibition would continue with the works still on display and indicated that he could seek another venue if necessary to show the full collection of protest photographs.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: Google co-founder Larry Page is the richest tech titan to leave California ahead of Billionaire's tax vote: How his exit may dent state’s $100 billion tax target
articles.summary: With Californians set to vote in just a few weeks on Proposition 40 – a measure proposing a one-time 5% wealth tax on the state's billionaires – Google
articles.body: With Californians set to vote in just a few weeks on Proposition 40 – a measure proposing a one-time 5% wealth tax on the state's billionaires – Google co-founder Larry Page has emerged as the wealthiest tech titan to sever ties with the state should the measure pass. His departure is likely to deal a significant blow to California's revenue projections as he will be the richest techie to leave the state. The initiative specifically targets billionaires who were state residents as of January 1, 2026. While a few prominent executives, such as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, have stated they are "perfectly fine" with the proposal, multiple ultra-wealthy residents chose to exit before the January deadline.Chief among them is the 53-year-old Page. Holding an estimated net worth of $292 billion, Page had deep roots in California spanning decades, Fortune reported, adding that had he remained a California resident past the cutoff date, he would have owed an estimated $15 billion under the one-time tax levy.Moving entities to Delaware and buying big in MiamiState filings have revealed that Page began unwinding his operational and personal presence in California late last year. According to an analysis of corporate records reported by Fortune, Page’s family office, Koop, was transferred out of California and officially incorporated in Delaware in late December. Multiple associated entities, including Flu Lab LLC, One Aero and Oceankind, followed the same route, moving their registrations from California to Delaware during the same month.Simultaneously, Page redirected significant capital toward luxury real estate on the East Coast. The Wall Street Journal reported that Page acquired two premier estates in Miami for a combined $173.4 million, which includes Coconut Grove Estate ($101.5 million, 11,855-square-foot property) and a neighboring parcel purchased for $71.9 million.The $29 billion dent in Prop 40’s targetThe departures of top-tier billionaires have already weakened the potential financial yield of the ballot measure. Prop 40 was projected to generate roughly $100 billion for the state. However, according to an estimate by Fortune, just four departed tech leaders – Larry Page, Sergey Brin, Peter Thiel and former Uber CEO Travis Kalanick – would have collectively owed approximately $29 billion. Their relocations before the residency cutoff mean the state has effectively lost out on more than a quarter of the measure's total projected revenue pool before ballots are even counted.Elon Musk, the richest person in the world, moved to Texas in 2020. Meanwhile, Jeff Bezos who recently but briefly secured the second richest person spot, departed Seattle for Miami in late 2023, eventually selling his Hunts Point home for a record $63 million to live in a $237 million Miami compound with his wife, Lauren Sánchez Bezos.You use AI every day. articles.body: MUMBAI: The three persons allegedly involved in the firing at actor Tiger Shroff were brought back to Mumbai from Kota on Wednesday morning and remanded in police custody till Oct 31.Preliminary ballistic reports have suggested the shooters while firing at actor Tiger Shroff used two factory-made firearms which are yet to be recovered. The three accused shooters-Phool Singh (18), Rehan Ansari (18), and Rithik Kumar alias Roshan (22)-who were arrested from Kota were produced before the 37th Metropolitan Magistrate Court which remanded them to police custody till Oct 31.Cops, while seeking police custody of the accused, told the court that the accused have destroyed the mobile phones used in connection with the crime, making the reconstruction of their communications through social media apps a key part of the investigation.Police are attempting to establish contact between the shooters and their alleged handlers, including Shubham Lonkar, through other digital evidence and their interrogation.The shooters had arrived in Mumbai on Sept 20, police said. "So far, investigation suggests the shooters and those who provided logistic support received around Rs 2 lakh, with which they bought a second-hand bike for Rs 25,000. Another Rs 37,000 was transferred in the account of Rehan Ansari. There were some more cash payments which are being ascertained," said Raj Tilak Roshan, deputy commissioner of police. Investigators are also examining the payments made through UPI applications and cash.Ansari and Singh's lawyer, Ajinkya Mirgal, argued that the police have already interrogated them in two days' transit remand and they should be sent to judicial custody.According to the preliminary investigation, Anil Pandit allegedly contacted Sameer, who also allegedly contacted Ansari.Ansari is suspected of having brought together Phool Singh and Rithik Kumar, the two accused alleged to have carried out the firing at Shroff.The five others, including two women, who have been arrested allegedly played roles in procuring, transporting and supplying weapons to the shooters and providing logistical support to the group. One of them, Radha, a bar girl, was a friend of accused Kunal. The duo came to Mumbai along with Babita, another accused. While Kunal left Mumbai the same day, the two women stayed in an Andheri lodge, delivered the weapons, and left later. They are being brought to Mumbai and will be produced before a court on Thursday.Sources associated with the probe suggested the accused monitored Shroff's movements through social media posts, videos and reels shared by the actor and his fans.
